final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ordervault AS ref, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin GROUP BY ordervault), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ref AS ref, s1.cnt AS cnt, s1.cnt * 1.0 / s2.total AS ratio FROM s1 CROSS JOIN s2 WHERE s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgcnt FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.ref AS ref, s3.cnt AS cnt, s3.ratio AS ratio, s3.cnt - s4.avgcnt AS diff FROM s3 CROSS JOIN s4 WHERE s4.avgcnt IS NOT NULL AND s3.cnt > s4.avgcnt) SELECT SUM(cnt), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM s5
